latency.metric: p95 over benchmark rows with content length <= 160 chars, measured by tools/profile_engine.mjs (field latency.sms160P95)
latency.note: Compare only against a measurement taken on the SAME machine with the SAME corpus. Recorded values ranged 11.27-27.97 ms across machines for code that never changed, so an absolute number carries no verdict on its own. A comparison run on the reviewer's machine must be paired with a baseline run of the previous commit.

rules: A gate may be changed only BEFORE the measurement it judges, and the change must be recorded here with a date and a reason.
A measurement that fails a gate is recorded as a failure; it is not grounds for widening the gate in the same session.
Any run against the held-out test set must be declared here before it is executed (review C2).

heldOutRunLog.note: Two or more decisions have now touched VSEC test, so it is a tuning set. The next generalization claim needs a NEW held-out set — ideally team-labelled real SMS — declared here before it is run.
